eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Eleven
subtitle: Lesson 103 · Database Design Fundamentals

code:
-- ProductName depends only on ProductID,
-- not the WHOLE (OrderID, ProductID) key
CREATE TABLE dbo.BadOrderLine (
  OrderID INT NOT NULL,
  ProductID INT NOT NULL,
  ProductName NVARCHAR(50),
  CONSTRAINT PK_BadOrderLine PRIMARY KEY (OrderID, ProductID)
);
caption: 2NF: every non-key column must depend on the ENTIRE composite key.

code:
SELECT d.SalesOrderID, d.OrderQty, p.Name AS ProductName
FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS d
JOIN Production.Product AS p
  ON p.ProductID = d.ProductID
WHERE d.SalesOrderID = 43659;
caption: SalesOrderDetail stores only ProductID — the name lives in Product, one join away.

code:
-- DepartmentName depends on DepartmentID,
-- not directly on EmployeeID (the key)
CREATE TABLE dbo.BadEmployee (
  EmployeeID INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  DepartmentID INT,
  DepartmentName NVARCHAR(50)
);
caption: 3NF: every non-key column must depend on nothing BUT the key — not on another non-key column.

code:
-- Does this column depend on...
-- 1. the key?          (1NF: atomic)
-- 2. the WHOLE key?     (2NF)
-- 3. NOTHING BUT the key? (3NF)
caption: A "no" to any of these points at a normal-form violation.
